summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the RDFLib SPARQL plugin. Changes: Update class added to sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update (empty-request path uses translatePrologue on the parsed declarations); evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py and exported from sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepared_update.py covers the specified cases. Nothing was run, per the instructions, so the new tests and the existing DAWG and prepareQuery tests are unverified. Nothing was committed.
